title: Course lists, completion and saved progress verified
summary: All 32 course, completion, persistence and history checks passed. Typecheck, focused lint and the local Expo web export also succeeded.

changes.detail: Verified exact lesson sequences and previous/next boundaries for every published curriculum path, plus lesson-list search and completion restoration through the real SchoolProvider after remount.
Course card headings now open course overviews; the reader uses one compact all-course-lessons link instead of the previous expandable browser card.
Continuation actions appear before optional notes. Changing lesson stages remounts the page to reset its scroll position.
Opening a lesson records stage zero so its in-progress status remains visible after visiting another lesson.
Updated completion interaction tests for automatic assessment completion while retaining explicit completion for lessons without quizzes, and preserving notes and practice drafts on restart.

validation.name: Typecheck and lint
validation.detail: tsc --noEmit and focused ESLint on all ten affected TS/TSX source files passed after final edits.

validation.name: Regression checks
validation.detail: 32 tests passed across course-flow, course-library, course-library-interaction, academy, academy-interaction, lesson-footer, progress and both history suites. Four affected interaction tests passed again after the final reader changes.

validation.name: Saved completion
validation.detail: The new interaction test uses the real SchoolProvider with test storage, verifies the serialized completion record and remounts the provider to confirm Completed/In progress labels restore.

validation.name: Web export
validation.detail: Offline local Expo export --platform web --output-dir artifacts/course-flow-web completed successfully; no deployment.

validation.name: Visual review and content scope
validation.detail: No connected browser/native UI is available for rendered mobile review. Newly written course content was not included; every existing published lesson is exposed and planned topics remain explicitly unpublished. Scroll resetting is implemented but not visually checked.
